verseText: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding...
meaning: Rather than trusting in what we think is right and true, we should trust totally in what God thinks is right and true.

recall.question: What should we not lean on?

meaning.question: To “lean on” something means to depend on it. What does trusting God instead of our own understanding mean?
choices: Trust that God knows better than us
Trust God only when we agree with Him
Trust in what we think is best

application.prompt: Sometimes your own idea seems best, but God sees things you cannot see and knows everything. Think of a choice you need to make. How could praying and learning what God says in the Bible help you decide what to do?
